negated-report.proposal: Report that the signal was not red at 14:20.

facts.evidence: The signed control log records a single observable aspect for signal S at 14:20. That aspect was green. A signal can display only one aspect at a time.
facts.authority: The dispatcher requested that the display answer whether the signal was red at that time.

different-subject-time.proposal: Report the observed temperature of chamber B at 14:25 as 21 degrees Celsius.

facts.evidence: The signed log has one entry: chamber A at 14:20, 24 degrees Celsius. No observation of chamber B is available.
facts.authority: The local operator asked what was measured in chamber B at 14:25.

future-change.proposal: At 14:25, switch pump P-2 from standby to flushing.

facts.evidence: A signed reading for P-2 at 14:20 records pump_mode=standby.
facts.authority: The operator requested and authorized switching P-2 to flushing at 14:25.
facts.effects: The future machine setting will change when the command is executed.
